stops.note: named the small carved toggle used to fasten a pouch to a kimono sash
toggles used to hang pouches from the sash of a kimono; Edmund de Waal's 'The Hare with Amber Eyes' (2010) tells of a netsuke collection
stops.meaning: a miniature Japanese carved toggle, now prized as art

current_meaning: a small, intricately carved Japanese toggle, now collected as miniature sculpture
